title: Neocortical and Hippocampal Theta Oscillations Track Audiovisual Integration and Replay of Speech Memories
description: Raw MEG dataset with T1-weighted anatomical scans and behavioural logfiles from an audiovisual speech memory experiment. Participants completed repeated blocks of encoding (audiovisual synchrony detection on speech movies), a distractor task, and cued retrieval of the auditory speech associated with a speaker's face. The data support analyses of neocortical and hippocampal theta oscillations in audiovisual integration and memory replay.
methods_description: MEG was recorded continuously during a single session per participant, split automatically into five runs. Each block comprised encoding, distractor (odd/even judgement), and retrieval tasks, with button-press responses. Event triggers mark movie onset, visual cue, speech stimuli, responses, and localisers. T1-weighted anatomical scans are available for some participants.
